description: Eight portable, independent skills for defining, researching, analyzing, evaluating, reviewing, validating, planning, and investigating.

interface.shortDescription: Reusable skills for clear, evidence-based work
interface.longDescription: Eight independent, portable instruction skills: Define, Research, Analyze, Evaluate, Review, Validate, Plan, and Investigate. Each skill focuses on a distinct reasoning or quality task, scopes its evidence and conclusions, and can run without a particular model, vendor, orchestration system, or peer skill. The package contains no MCP server, app connection, executable tool, remote service, or background automation. Results depend on host tools, available evidence, and the user's task.
defaultPrompt: Research this technical question and distinguish verified facts from uncertainty
Review this design and prioritize evidence-backed findings
Validate this change against its acceptance criteria
